title: SS27 Boys' Couture Materials and Details
summary: Premium materials for boyswear: certified organic cotton, fine linen, soft leather sandals and recycled performance fabrics.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Collections increasingly use recycled fibres, organic cotton and certified materials<sup>[1]</sup>
- Pisamonas showed strap ballerinas, leather sandals, barefoot models and first-summer shoes for babies<sup>[2]</sup>
- Gray Label keeps to a minimalist range with no patterns except stripes, in "exceptionally soft" pieces made in Portugal<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Materials
sections.body:
- Organic cotton jersey.
- Linen and linen-cotton shirting.
- Leather sandals.
- Recycled swim and track fabrics.

design_implications:
- Fewer, better materials.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Premium on certified and leather pieces.
